# Investigate-first debugging discipline

Curated by Skill Harbor — a short pointer to @juliusbrussee's investigate-first method: a five-rule debugging discipline for ambiguous failures — separate the observed symptom from the inferred cause, trace inputs, state transitions, ownership boundaries and failure output, rank hypotheses by evidence and cheap falsification value, and make no fix until one credible mechanism explains the evidence, stopping exploration the moment the cause or the exact blocker is named. Honest caveats: **no license declared in the repository — license unknown**, so this is a short fiche linking to the source, without reusing its content; it is a process guide only, it ships no tooling or scripts.
